nodes.description:
Local variables allow you to store and modify values throughout a workflow. Unlike request variables, local variables are defined within the workflow and can be modified at different steps. 

How to use:  
1. In the name selector, click “Add variable” to create a new variable in your workflow.  
2. Use the “Set Variable” node in different steps of your flow and change the value.  
3. Reference the variable in nodes, logic or conditions. 

Local variables make workflows more flexible, helping you manage dynamic data more efficiently.
